title: My Stepdaughter Forged The Deed And Sold My House From Under Me In Rehab. So I Voided The Sale
description: At 57, after 30 years as a night-shift hospital housekeeper, I had paid off my $240,000 ranch house. My stepdaughter forged a transfer-on-death deed, sold the house to a flipper for $360,000 while I was in rehab, and mailed me a $4,700 rent check. I found the original deed in a church lockbox, voided the sale, and now run Threshold of Deceit Vacation Rentals where she scrubs baseboards in a smock that says Deeded Me Out. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #DeedFraud
thumb_text: SHE FORGED THE DEED, I VOIDED THE SALE
pinned_comment: If your stepdaughter forged a transfer-on-death deed and sold your paid-off house for $360,000 while you were in rehab, would you have voided the sale and made her scrub baseboards, or would you have just taken the $4,700 check? Tell me your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: WHILE I WAS IN REHAB SHE MAILED ME A RENT CHECK
